# Chronoglobe Atlas

> Sourced, citable data for chronoglobe.si. Polities, rulers, capitals, borders, and layers through time. Every fact has a permanent id, date bounds, one confidence label, and sources.

Outside submissions are not open yet. Do not add polities, rulers, capitals, borders, layers, or sources. Do not invent facts, dates, borders, or citations. Files under `examples/` are illustrations, not historical claims. Their years are 9000 so they cannot be confused with history.

## How to read the repo

- `schema/` is the contract. JSON Schema, draft 2020-12: source, polity, ruler, capital, border, layer. Shared fragments are in `schema/common.schema.json`.
- `examples/` holds the only checked-in records. Each one sets `example: true` and includes the words `not a historical claim` in `note`. Do not treat them as data and do not cite their ids as history.
- `sources/`, `polities/`, `rulers/`, `capitals/`, `borders/`, and `layers/` are the real collections. v0 leaves them empty on purpose. Human-edited files may be YAML or JSON, one object per file. The filename stem is the id.
- `verify/` is the validator. `python3 -m verify` checks the tree. `python3 -m verify.bundle` writes `dist/` after a clean check. Do not commit `dist/`.
- `docs/CITING.md` is the citation form. A fact URL is `https://chronoglobe.si/f/<id>@<version>`. `<version>` is the dataset release in `CITATION.cff`. Each release is archived on Zenodo for a DOI. v0.1.0 has no DOI yet. Do not invent one.

Confidence, exactly one: `attested`, `scholarly-consensus`, `estimate`, `reconstructed`, `contested`, `legendary`.

An estimate requires a low, a high, and a method, with low <= high. Layer estimates use `value_low`, `value_high`, and `method`. A contested fact may carry `alternatives`. Each alternative has its own sources. Other labels must not carry alternatives.

Every fact cites at least one source id that exists under `sources/`. A source has an id, authors, title, year, and a publisher, DOI, or URL. License is recorded where it matters. Negative years are BCE. `-1` is 1 BCE. Year 0 is not rewritten. `earliest` must be <= `latest`.

Ids are permanent lowercase slugs (`letters`, digits, single hyphens), unique in the tree, and equal to the filename stem.

Borders: one shape per polity, year, and source. Geometry is a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, or a `geometry_ref` to one `.geojson` file in the same license folder. `provenance: historical-basemaps-gpl` is allowed only under `borders/gpl/` (and `examples/borders/gpl/`). That folder sets `derived_from_gpl: true` and cites a source with `dataset: historical-basemaps` and a GPL license. `borders/ccby/` sets `provenance: fresh-drawn`, `derived_from_gpl: false`, and `fresh_source` to a source with `dataset: fresh-drawn` and a non-GPL license. A CC-BY border must not cite a GPL or historical-basemaps source and must not reference a file under a `gpl/` folder.

Layers are `population`, `gdp`, `climate`, and `governance`. The `layer` field matches the directory. A layer has `value_low`, `value_high`, `unit`, `method`, and source ids, and names a `polity` or a `subject`.

In YAML, quote `yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `y`, and `n`. Unquoted, YAML 1.1 turns them into booleans. `true` and `false` are real booleans and may stay unquoted.

## Bundles

`dist/manifest.json` lists small JSON files, one per layer per century, plus `sources.json`. A record is copied into every century its span overlaps. `century_start` is the mathematical floor of the year divided by 100, times 100, not truncation toward zero. The file for year Y has `century_start = floor(Y / 100) * 100`. Example records go to `*.examples.json`. `borders/gpl` and `borders/ccby` are separate files and keep their own licenses. The site should load one of those files for the year on screen, not the whole atlas.

## Validate locally

From the repository root:

```
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
make validate
make test
```

`make validate` runs `python3 -m verify`. `make test` runs the good and bad fixtures, including an unquoted YAML `no`, a GPL provenance tag outside `borders/gpl/`, a CC-BY border derived from GPL, a dangling source, and a duplicate id. All of those must fail.

## Contributing

Not open yet. When it opens, `CONTRIBUTING.md` is the rule: no invented history, no invented sources, no unmarked examples. Code is MIT (`LICENSE`). Data is CC-BY-4.0 (`LICENSE-DATA`). `borders/gpl/` is GPL-3.0. Cite the atlas with `CITATION.cff`.
